evidence: minisvc/storage/repo.py:17-22 writes directly to SQLite; no backup, migration, busy timeout, or retry policy
impact: Data loss, lock failures, and schema evolution problems can affect production behavior
mitigation: Define backup/recovery and migration practices; add bounded retry/timeout handling and storage tests

evidence: minisvc/audit.py:4-10 returns an event dict only; minisvc/storage/repo.py:11-15 creates no audit table
impact: Create and read activity is not durable or independently queryable
mitigation: Add an audit table/repository and decide whether order plus audit writes require one transaction

evidence: minisvc/config.py:10-13 parses MINISVC_READONLY, but cli.py:8-10 and handlers.py:12 never enforce or propagate it; default DB is relative orders.sqlite
impact: Readonly expectations can be violated and separate working directories can select different databases
mitigation: Pass settings into the service/repository, enforce readonly at every write boundary, and use an explicit deployment path

evidence: minisvc/api/handlers.py:6-11 indexes required keys and calls int(payload['total_cents']) with no schema, range, or semantic validation
impact: Malformed, missing, negative, or nonsensical orders can cause 500s or invalid data
mitigation: Add request schema validation, nonnegative/business-limit checks, and defined 4xx error mapping

evidence: minisvc/api/handlers.py:12 and storage/repo.py:17-22 allow sqlite3 exceptions to propagate; duplicate order_id is a primary-key failure
impact: Clients receive undefined failures and retries may duplicate requests or obscure conflicts
mitigation: Map integrity/operational errors to stable responses and establish idempotency semantics
